incidents.name: CvxRewardDistributor claimMultipleStaking
incidents.notes: claimMultipleStaking() did not check that entries of the claimContracts array were registered staking contracts, so a caller-supplied fake contract was invoked as a staking service and returned reward amounts that minted 58M CVG to the attacker.

sources.ref: onchain review: CvxRewardDistributor proxy 0x2b083bea... created by 0xfffde9a2bb7c9a6dfd1f0235f5af4f599e3265ec on 2024-07-14, single Upgraded event to impl 0x47c69e8c909ce626af73c955a5e34a20b7c71f19 in the creation block; exploited 17.9 days later
